landing.what_desc: We automate your processes with artificial intelligence tools designed around the real needs of your business. We combine analytics, data science, and machine learning to detect opportunities, anticipate demand, and deliver actionable information to every team.
landing.value_automation_desc: We map your operation and turn it into conversational experiences that capture useful data without losing your brand's human tone.
landing.value_analytics_desc: We integrate your sources, clean the signal, and build dashboards that tell the full story of your business in real time.
landing.value_ml_desc: We train models that learn from your operation to segment, recommend, and detect patterns before they become problems.
landing.service_desc_1: Our AI never sleeps, but there are always humans ready to step in. If a conversation needs empathy or judgment, our team takes over without endless tickets or canned responses.
landing.service_desc_2: Think of it as a digital concierge that detects intent, prepares the right person, and keeps your customers informed. That is 24/7 customer service with human quality and machine speed.
landing.plans_desc_1: We design modular packages to activate
landing.plans_desc_3: Choose the plan you need today and scale with us when you are ready.
landing.price_note: * Prices in MXN. VAT not included. We can combine plans or build a custom one.
client_requirements: Starter: website where the widget can be embedded and base FAQs
WhatsApp: approved WhatsApp Business API account and provider (Meta Cloud API or Twilio) paid by the client
E-commerce add-on: active Stripe account and catalog_url/product or price IDs
Web packages: content, branding, and desired structure; for e-commerce, catalog and preferred integration
Stripe is configured only when the e-commerce add-on is purchased
Founders Plan: starting with the second module or package in the same tenant, 50% off (except WhatsApp add-on unless an active promo applies)
general_conditions: Included monthly usage: 1M input tokens + 1M output tokens per tenant; overages are charged with additional token bundles
Included models: GPT-4o mini family; premium models or extended context are quoted separately
External payments: Stripe fees and WhatsApp providers (Meta/Twilio/BSP) are paid by the client
We work exclusively with Twilio or Meta Cloud API for WhatsApp, depending on country availability
Annual term (12 months) with automatic renewal; cancellation requires 30 days notice
SLA: support during business hours, critical incidents handled with best effort; major changes are quoted separately
Continuous widget updates, security patches, and compatibility with new releases
Each client is responsible for policies, legal text, and legitimate use of their data
